plain_english_policy: The item asks for a specific tax level without defining the direction of change (increase or decrease), making it non-ideological and indeterminate.
evidence_quote: Indicate the tax levels you will support. Select one level only.
review_reason: Item lacks directional context; selecting a 'level' does not inherently indicate conservative (higher) or progressive (lower) stance without knowing if it is an increase or decrease from current rates.
